statement.zh: 洛斯加维拉内斯前陶玉米遗存可作为中安第斯最早玉米驯化/引种的关键证据。
statement.en: Los Gavilanes Preceramic maize remains are decisive evidence for the earliest Andean maize domestication/introduction.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: early maize identification, dating, and staple intensity at Los Gavilanes remain debated; PNAS 2013 and other multiproxy studies contest single-site priority narratives. Not a fact-column claim.
